description: Create an account and save its API key locally for the other tools. The key and a confirmation link are mailed to the address; the address becomes a forwarding destination once the link is opened. The setup flow: signup (once) -> add_domain -> publish the returned DNS records at the domain's DNS host -> verify_domain -> set_alias. Mail is forwarded only to destinations confirmed through the link mailed to them.
name: signup
title: Create an mxgate account
